verdict.rationale: Evidence shows general customer/contact management (zoho-books-docs-1) and customizable reports with filters and date ranges (zoho-books-supp-accountant), plus accountant collaboration access to real-time books data, but nothing explicitly documents an AR aging report or per-customer outstanding balance feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an accounts receivable aging report, per-customer balance/statement views, or overdue invoice tracking by customer.
